scenarios.name: delayed_signatures
scenarios.note: Endorsement weight arrives in two batches; the second crosses the threshold before Commit.

scenarios.name: asymmetric_delivery
scenarios.note: A replica that never received the commit record stays at endorsed; it cannot self-activate and keeps the old assignment authoritative for every round.

scenarios.name: missed_earliest_activation
scenarios.note: Observed root round passes A_min before Commit; activation waits for the committed A*, not the proposed start.

scenarios.name: crash_at_prepared
scenarios.note: Resume from the durable phase; the next phase cannot be skipped.

scenarios.name: crash_at_frozen
scenarios.note: Resume from the durable phase; the next phase cannot be skipped.

scenarios.name: crash_at_endorsed
scenarios.note: Resume from the durable phase; the next phase cannot be skipped.

scenarios.name: crash_at_committed
scenarios.note: Resume from the durable phase; the next phase cannot be skipped.

scenarios.name: old_quorum_loss_after_prepare
scenarios.note: Old quorum is unavailable after Prepare; endorsement cannot complete and the handoff stalls with the old set still authoritative.

scenarios.name: committed_abort_vs_late_activate
scenarios.note: Once committed, Abort is rejected; once aborted, Activate is rejected. Conflicting records cannot both take effect.

scenarios.name: aborted_then_activate_rejected
scenarios.note: A pre-commit abort kills attempt j; Activate is impossible afterwards; a replacement needs attempt j+1.

scenarios.name: incomplete_prepare_then_clock
scenarios.note: Prepare only, then the round counter reaches the proposed start: no activation.

scenarios.name: incomplete_prepare_then_rest_insertion
scenarios.note: A locally submitted trust base (simulated as an Activate with no committed record) is rejected.

phase_order_interleavings.note: All 24 orderings of the four core phases are run; only the canonical order reaches a committed handoff, and no ordering authorises the new assignment before commit.
